title: Tank storage.
officialText: Storage areas for flammable and combustible liquid tanks inside of structures shall be located at or above grade and shall be separated from the processing area by not less than 2-hour fire-resistance-rated fire barriers constructed in accordance with Section 707 or horizontal assemblies constructed in accordance with Section 712, or both.
